author: fable-cursor
criterion: Overhead reads as a dense, layered canopy with light breaking through like the top of the reference frames.
note: From F the upper half is a flat pale-grey sky with a few single-tone dark-green lobes (the near-canopy discs, survey-2 #07), Saria's eave with pods at the top left and a bare orange trunk at the right. There are no layered leaf masses and no light breaking through - the 1.6 % sky fraction is met because flat disc silhouettes cover the sky, not a canopy. The reference F has dense dark leaf masses at both top corners with four shafts leaning down-right through a bright gap. Crops x 0.0-0.5 and 0.5-1.0, y 0.0-0.42.
